Full summary: Audited whether the repo has analyzed/responded to two inbound field docs (2026-08-17 wave-2 verification reply; TWINING-ROUTING-UPSTREAM). Answer: neither — both unanswered. Ran a 5-lane parallel sweep across git (all branches), repo-wide rg, the .twining store (rg + direct SQL over sqlite blackboard/decisions), gh issues/PRs, and the assistant memory dir. Posted a finding and a warning; corrected the stale "no field response yet" line in memory and added a new memory for the routing lane.</summary>
<decisions>["Classified the twining_verify cost ask as partially addressed rather than addressed — the runtime half shipped in 2.16.0 via 8809cff but arrived through the DIFFERENT 2026-08-15 read audit (S2-C) and predates the field's own measurement run, while the ~198K-token payload and 120s budget half are deferred to unshipped W4; considered calling it addressed and rejected that because the field has not been told and half the ask is open","Treated routing proposal 1 as a supersession request against a named decision rather than a new bug — issue #46 explicitly considered and declined the exact hardening, and decision 01KY68QN70W0RRWCNMWH57WNEW records --project/TWINING_PROJECT as never redirected; any response must engage that rationale instead of treating the item as unexamined","Explicitly ruled read-audit item S1-E out as coverage for routing proposal 2 — both use the word ancestor but S1-E is scope-string prefix matching inside a bound store while proposal 2 is the filesystem walk that decides which store binds; recording the disambiguation because a keyword search makes them look like the same item","Reported the assessment without fixing anything — the user asked which docs we had already handled, not for remediation; the lineage forward-only defect is live in HEAD at src/engine/decisions.ts:695-700 and 773-795 but changing it is a scope decision the user has not made"]</decisions>
</invoke>
